text.content:
"It's all about the touch."

Headquarters: Dynalar Complex (#15), Charter Hill (regional)
Industry: Cyberlimbs and prosthetics
In Night City: One of the three campus corps whose consortium polices Charter Hill
Known for: Provocative advertising; paid test-subject programs

A cyberware manufacturer best known for its suggestive ads. Its Charter Hill complex builds cyberlimbs and prosthetics and hires test subjects. It pays well; ask what for.

With Kiroshi and Rocklin, Dynalar runs the Charter Hill security consortium, which took over the hill's security after Militech's contract quietly lapsed. Its seconds turn up for sale on the west slope out of the back of a van.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.22; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 09
